summary: Encode mutating Stripe API requests as application/x-www-form-urlencoded instead of JSON.
reason: Stripe rejects JSON request bodies for write endpoints. The generated commands still build JSON-shaped maps, so the shared client now flattens them into Stripe bracket notation before sending. Form-encoding is scoped to POST/PUT/PATCH (DELETE stays JSON), MCP adapters' pre-marshaled []byte bodies are decoded before flattening, and arrays mixing scalars with objects use consistent indexed keys.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover write-method selection with DELETE excluded, POST content type, nested bracket fields, indexed object arrays, repeated scalar array fields, MCP pre-marshaled []byte bodies, and mixed scalar/object arrays.
